object_description: radically compact stacked volume in the fall line of the slope with a suspended service tube
design_condition: the compact volume is positioned as far as possible from the existing building in the fall line of the slope, taking the minimum footprint set by the sports hall so the open space can be renaturalised and cold air can flow

positive: The design bases itself on ecology and efficiency and implements them consistently at all levels
Positioning the radically compact volume in the fall line leaves plenty of space for a renaturalised open space
This is expected to provide a good flow of cold air and to enclose the sports fields and playgrounds
The building takes the minimum possible footprint given by the sports hall dimensions
The pool is suspended above the sports hall so that it is well lit from both sides and needs little artificial light
The rectangular floor area can easily accommodate the large rooms of the canteen
The sustainability tube is a recognisable element containing music rooms and a rainwater tank
The direct, inventive implementation of the sustainability criteria is fascinating
The structure, the testing of new elements and the somewhat technoid but pleasant atmosphere were appreciated
The search for an architecture ready to abandon some supposed paradigms is welcomed
negative: The tube takes light away from the rooms behind it and seems unsuitable as a covered break area
The upper classroom floors have less attractive arrangements with central corridors
Shortcomings are evident at the level of school operations
Entrance halls are lacking and access routes over many floors are unattractive
Long corridors leave little scope for different teaching methods
The overall complex reads as two parts that communicate little with each other
The priority of one topic cannot prevent the whole complexity of the task from being taken into account
